name: vivarium-ai-tools
description: Marketplace for the IHME Simulation Science Team ai-tools plugins: simsci (generic developer workflows for any IHME team) and simsci-internal (SimSci/vivarium-specific workflows).

plugins.name: simsci
plugins.description: Generic AI developer workflows for any IHME team, any repo: multi-agent code review and review-to-PR prep, git rescue, commit splitting, type hinting, regression debugging, change propagation, workflow assessment, and a guided TDD loop.

plugins.name: simsci-internal
plugins.description: SimSci/vivarium-specific workflows (model development, team conventions, vivarium references). Depends on simsci — installing simsci-internal brings in both.
